name: Tadaoka (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tadaoka town emblem in white: a ring open at the top with a vertical bar, enclosing a stylised letter M.
history: Municipal flag of Tadaoka, a town in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 October 1973; the emblem dates from 1 February 1973.

features.role: Tadaoka town emblem — a ring open at the top with a vertical bar, enclosing a stylised letter M
